title: Xbox Reveals Alligator-Shaped Series X Ahead of GTA 6
description: Xbox has introduced a one-of-a-kind alligator-shaped Series X console to celebrate the upcoming launch of GTA 6, and you can win it.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Xbox Brings Leonida Wildlife to Life with Custom Console

As the launch of GTA 6 draws ever closer, promotional activities are heating up across the gaming industry. According to a report by IGN, Xbox is celebrating the upcoming release by bringing the unique wildlife of Leonida straight into players' living rooms through a specially crafted, one-of-a-kind console.

## A Wild Design for a Major Launch

The custom hardware features an alligator-shaped design, perfectly capturing the aesthetic of Leonida, the fictional setting of the highly anticipated sequel. With GTA 6 just weeks away from release, this alligator-themed Series X serves as a creative nod to the environment that players will soon be exploring.

## Win It Before GTA 6 Arrives

For dedicated fans looking to get into the spirit of the new game, Xbox is offering a chance to win this unique console before GTA 6 officially launches. While standard editions are widely available, this one-of-a-kind collectible stands out as a unique piece of gaming memorabilia for the community.

## Editor's Take

Custom hardware always generates excitement, and this alligator-themed Xbox Series X is a fun way to lean into the Leonida vibe ahead of GTA 6. It is a clever promotional push that highlights the cultural impact of the game's impending release.
